title: China punishes prominent academics exposed by research sleuth
title_zh: 中国对研究侦探曝光的知名学者实施惩罚
abstract: Several scientists investigated for research-integrity violations by video-blogger ‘Student Geng’ have now faced disciplinary measures. The penalties are part of a misconduct crackdown on 31 research teams.
abstract_zh: 一名视频博主‘学生耿’曝光的多名科学家因研究诚信违规被调查，现已受到纪律处分。这些处罚是对31支研究团队的违规行为进行打击的一部分。
snippet: Several scientists investigated for research-integrity violations by video-blogger ‘Student Geng’ have now faced disciplinary measures. The penalties are part of a misconduct crackdown on 31 research teams.
